exposure: BMI groups (normal BMI (20-24.9 kg/m2) as the reference group)
cohort: 1121 gestational carriers (GCs) who underwent first embryo transfer
finding: The study found no significant associations between gestational carrier BMI and good perinatal outcomes, live birth, clinical pregnancy, biochemical pregnancy, spontaneous abortion, or low birth weight.
mod_finding: Higher BMI was significantly associated with birth by cesarean delivery and large for gestational age infants.
